dynamic_line: If you think we're ready, I think we can try another go.  Even… even if it's too late for Uncle Barry, I think we've got to try to take that damn tower out of commission.

responses.text: All right.  Let's kick some alien butt.
Is there anyone else around here that could help us?
You mentioned that Carlos, Eddie and Luke probably can't help in a firefight.  Is there any other way we could use them?
